description: This file defines the Locator class and related classes for element selection and interaction in a web automation framework, including methods for element actions, attribute retrieval, and locator composition.

classes.name: Locator
classes.description: Represents a DOM element locator with methods for element interaction, attribute access, and locator composition.

classes.name: FrameLocator
classes.description: Represents a locator scoped within a specific frame, allowing nested element selection.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Locator with a frame, selector, and optional parameters.

methods.name: _withElement
methods.description: Executes a task with an element handle, managing timeouts and disposal.

methods.name: _equals
methods.description: Checks if two locators are equal based on frame and selector.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the page associated with the locator's frame.

methods.name: boundingBox
methods.description: Gets the bounding box of the element.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks a checkbox or similar element.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks the element.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: Double-clicks the element.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a DOM event on the element.

methods.name: dragTo
methods.description: Performs drag and drop to a target locator.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the context of the element.

methods.name: _evaluateFunction
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript function declaration in the element's context.

methods.name: evaluateAll
methods.description: Evaluates a function on all matched elements.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Returns a handle to the result of evaluating a function.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills an input element with a value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input element.

methods.name: _highlight
methods.description: Highlights the element (used internally).

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights the element.

methods.name: locator
methods.description: Creates a nested locator.

methods.name: getByTestId
methods.description: Gets a locator by test ID.

methods.name: getByAltText
methods.description: Gets a locator by alt text.

methods.name: getByLabel
methods.description: Gets a locator by label text.

methods.name: getByPlaceholder
methods.description: Gets a locator by placeholder text.

methods.name: getByText
methods.description: Gets a locator by visible text.

methods.name: getByTitle
methods.description: Gets a locator by title attribute.

methods.name: getByRole
methods.description: Gets a locator by ARIA role.

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a frame locator scoped within the current locator.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the locator with additional options.

methods.name: elementHandle
methods.description: Returns an element handle for the locator.

methods.name: elementHandles
methods.description: Returns all element handles matching the locator.

methods.name: contentFrame
methods.description: Returns a FrameLocator for nested frames.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Adds a description to the locator.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the description of the locator.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a locator for the first matching element.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a locator for the last matching element.

methods.name: nth
methods.description: Returns a locator for the nth matching element.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Combines locators with logical AND.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Combines locators with logical OR.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the element.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Blurs the element.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of matched elements.

methods.name: _resolveSelector
methods.description: Resolves the selector via the channel.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Gets an attribute value.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Hovers over the element.

methods.name: innerHTML
methods.description: Gets inner HTML.

methods.name: innerText
methods.description: Gets inner text.

methods.name: inputValue
methods.description: Gets the input value.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Checks if the element is checked.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the element is disabled.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Checks if the element is editable.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the element is enabled.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Checks if the element is hidden.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the element is visible.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing a key.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the element.

methods.name: ariaSnapshot
methods.description: Returns an ARIA snapshot.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls the element into view if needed.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options in a select element.

methods.name: selectText
methods.description: Selects text within the element.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Sets the checked state.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files for input elements.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on the element.

methods.name: textContent
methods.description: Gets the text content.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into the element.

methods.name: pressSequentially
methods.description: Types text sequentially.

methods.name: uncheck
methods.description: Unchecks a checkbox.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all matching locators.

methods.name: allInnerTexts
methods.description: Returns inner texts of all matched elements.

methods.name: allTextContents
methods.description: Returns text contents of all matched elements.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.description: Waits for the element to meet a condition.

methods.name: _expect
methods.description: Performs an expectation check.

methods.name: _inspect
methods.description: Returns string representation for inspection.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string description of the locator.
